D: A primary school teacher accidentally promises that Hollywood is coming to see his school's nativity play.
P: Serve the sweets when the nativity play starts.
S: the staffroom at St Bernadette's at Christmas

Buttery mince pies with crumbly star lids, dusted with icing sugar and served warm with orange-scented whipped cream. Cut 12 rounds from 2 sheets shortcrust pastry and press into a greased patty pan tin. Fill each with 1 heaped tbsp fruit mince from a 400g jar. Cut 12 stars from a third sheet and lay on top. Brush with beaten egg and bake at 190C for 18 minutes until golden. Whip 200ml thickened cream with 1 tbsp icing sugar and the zest of 1 orange. Dust the pies with icing sugar and serve warm with the cream.
Christmas fair pork and apple rolls
the school Christmas fair bake sale

Golden puff pastry rolls of pork, apple and sage, glazed with egg and sprinkled with seeds, with a tangy tomato relish for dipping. Mix 500g pork sausage mince with 1 grated apple, 1 grated onion, 2 tbsp chopped sage and 30g breadcrumbs. Cut 2 sheets puff pastry in half, lay a log of filling along each and roll up, sealing underneath. Brush with beaten egg, sprinkle with 1 tbsp sesame seeds and cut each into 4. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until golden. Serve with 200g tomato relish.
M: Roast chicken with pigs in blankets, crunchy roast potatoes, maple-glazed Brussels sprouts with bacon and plenty of gravy. Rub a 1.8kg chicken with butter and salt and roast at 200C for 1 hour 15 minutes. Wrap 12 chipolatas in half rashers of streaky bacon and add for the last 30 minutes. Roast 1kg parboiled potatoes in oil for 50 minutes. Halve 400g Brussels sprouts and fry with 2 diced rashers bacon for 6 minutes, then toss with 1 tbsp maple syrup. Make gravy from the pan juices with 1 tbsp flour and 350ml chicken stock.
W: Mr Poppy, the classroom assistant who is a big kid

Warm crumbled Christmas pudding layered with vanilla ice cream, custard, toffee sauce and crushed honeycomb in tall sundae glasses. Warm an 800g Christmas pudding in the microwave or steamer as the packet says, then break half of it into chunks. Warm 300ml thick vanilla custard. In 4 sundae glasses, layer pudding chunks, a scoop of vanilla ice cream, a spoon of custard and a drizzle of toffee sauce, then repeat. Finish with whipped cream from 150ml thickened cream and 40g crushed honeycomb.
K: a cold December night at the school nativity

Blackcurrant cordial warmed with cloudy apple juice, cinnamon, orange and ginger, served steaming in mugs for the kids. Pour 1L cloudy apple juice and 400ml water into a saucepan with 150ml blackcurrant cordial, 2 cinnamon sticks, 4 cloves, 2 slices fresh ginger and 1 sliced orange. Heat gently for 10 minutes without boiling. Strain into 4 mugs and add an orange slice to each.
